buyer_claim: The Boba Fett figure I received has more paint wear than described and the blaster appears to be a reproduction, not original. The listing said 'Very Good' condition with '95%+ paint intact' but the paint on the knee joints is significantly worn and the blaster plastic has a different texture from authentic 1979 Kenner blasters. I've been collecting vintage Star Wars for 15 years and this doesn't match what I expected.
seller_response: This is a genuine 1979 Kenner Boba Fett in very good condition. The buyer is mischaracterizing normal surface texture variation on the knee joints as 'paint wear' — there is no paint loss beyond what's disclosed in the listing. The 95%+ paint rating is accurate for the total figure surface. The blaster is original Kenner. I've provided my professional inspection report and a certificate from a vintage toy authentication service confirming authenticity and condition.
